messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: metering_consumer_reprocess_loop fired (sev=high) -> https://pagerduty.com/INC-76231 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Alert details: service: metering-ingest, symptom: consumer lag + duplicate token increments, trigger: consumer_reprocess_count > 5/min

maria.sre: acked and taking lead. I'm looking at consumer group offsets and the ingest shard logs. pinging @samir-metering.

samir-metering: on it. seeing repeated rebalances on consumer-group metering-consumers-7. offsets going backwards (~3000 offsets rewound) which explains duplicate token counts. likely producer retry + out-of-order commit. grabbing logs.

maria.sre: copy. quick check: are we seeing DLQ growth? could be poison messages triggering retries.

samir-metering: DLQ steady. not many poison. patchy commit failure logs:
```
2026-03-14T18:20:10Z metering-consumer-7 ERROR CommitFailedException: Offset 124512 not found
2026-03-14T18:20:11Z metering-consumer-7 INFO Reprocessing message id=msg-9a3f, retry=3
2026-03-14T18:20:12Z metering-consumer-7 WARN Detected duplicate message for customer_id=cust_42 token_count=+1
```

tiara-support: any immediate customer impact? I just got a flag from billing ops — a batch invoice job pulled yesterday's inflated counts and queued for generation.

kevin-billing: confirmed — nightly invoice job for a small set of enterprise customers pulled tokens from the aggregation table at 02:00 UTC. If counts are inflated, invoices risk being incorrect. We need a stopgap before invoice generation finishes (est. 45m).

maria.sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause nightly invoice job (billing run state -> paused) 2) disable consumer autoscaler to prevent rapid rebalances 3) apply a temporary dedupe filter in aggregation service for timestamps within reprocess window. I'm executing step 1 now.

maria.sre: /runbook metering-ingest -> step 2 (pause downstream jobs) -> run: playbook pause_invoices.sh

samir-metering: pausing consumer autoscaler now:
```
kubectl scale deployment metering-consumer-autoscaler --replicas=0 -n prod-metering
```

samir-metering: adding a short-lived dedupe guard in aggregator: filter by (message_id, processed_window) for last 1h. patch pushed to canary.

maria.sre: @eve-evening-oncall can you take the handoff in 20m? I'm going to validate metrics from the canary and coordinate with billing to safely resume invoice job.

eve-evening-oncall: I can take it. will watch the canary and hold resume until you give green. acked on PD. :white_check_mark:

tiara-support: letting the affected customers know: sending templated note to billing contacts explaining paused invoice generation due to anomaly; will update when we have timeline.

kevin-billing: thanks. Quick ask: can we snapshot the aggregated totals before resume so we can diff and revert any invoices if needed?

samir-metering: yes — taking a consistent read from aggregation store now and exporting to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/2876543210/agg-snapshot.csv

maria.sre: initial metric checks: consumer-lag peaked at ~12k messages, reprocess_count ~8/min, duplicate-token-events ~1.2k in 30m window. Canary agg shows dedupe reduces duplicates to ~15 events. Looks good.

maria.sre: coordinating with billing: will resume invoices only after 2 consecutive 5m windows with duplicates < 20. target ~15m.

eve-evening-oncall: taking over active pager. I'll keep this thread updated and escalate to SRE lead if duplicates reappear. handing off to @eve-evening-oncall (on-call shift).

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident assigned to eve-evening-oncall. Next escalation path: SRE-leads if not acknowledged in 10m.

tiara-support: customer note sent to primary contacts for affected accounts: "Invoice generation paused due to token-count instability. We're investigating and will update in 15 minutes."

kevin-billing: appreciated. please include the snapshot path in the follow-up so ops can reconcile if needed.

samir-metering: snapshot uploaded and checksums posted: s3://redwood-incidents/2876543210/agg-snapshot.csv sha256: d2f7...

maria.sre: 15m update: canary stable, duplicates suppressed, consumer lag trending down. Billing: clear to resume in 5m if no regressions.

tiara-support: updated customers with a 30m ETA.

kevin-billing: resuming invoice job now (manual trigger). monitoring invoice job logs.

samir-metering: watching aggregation; diffs vs snapshot within expected variance. no large deltas for top customers.

maria.sre: closing mitigation loop: re-enabled autoscaler, removed temporary dedupe after stable window, documented incident in runbook (postmortem pending).

eve-evening-oncall: incident acknowledged as contained. I'll open a follow-up postmortem doc and tag the metering + billing teams.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved (INC-76231) — status: resolved by eve-evening-oncall. :white_check_mark:

maria.sre: thanks team — good work. action items: (1) permanent fix for commit failures (samir) (2) add invoice run pre-check for token-fluctuation (kevin/ops) (3) postmortem + RCA (maria).

kevin-billing: noted. I'll coordinate on the invoice pre-check and runbook changes.

samir-metering: will triage root cause and propose fix for producer retry handling.

maria.sre: marking thread for postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
